SHA512 chains exact NEGOTIATE and SESSION_SETUP bytes from64 zero bytes through the final client request; the final successful response is excluded from the KDF context. The exported mechanism key is the Windows KILE AP-REP acceptor subkey. HMAC-SHA256 counter KDF derives SigningKey, ApplicationKey, C2SCipherKey and S2CCipherKey with distinct NUL-terminated labels and the64-byte transcript hash. AES-CMAC protects the final session response and TREE_CONNECT. The share encryption flag requires AES128-GCM transforms for file traffic; authenticate the tag before decoding any inner message. All expressions are symbolic.
